description: Retrieves a list of Stripe charges with filtering and pagination; use valid cursor IDs from previous responses for pagination, and note that charges are typically returned in reverse chronological order.

created.description: Filters charges by creation date using a dictionary with keys like 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte' and Unix timestamp values.
created.title: Created

customer.description: Filters charges by the specified customer ID.
customer.title: Customer

ending_before.description: Cursor for pagination. A charge ID that defines your place in the list; returns charges listed before this charge. Use a charge ID from a previous response to fetch the previous page.
ending_before.title: Ending Before

limit.description: Maximum number of charges to return (default: 10).
limit.title: Limit

payment_intent.description: Filters charges by the specified PaymentIntent ID.
payment_intent.title: Payment Intent

starting_after.description: Cursor for pagination. A charge ID that defines your place in the list; returns charges listed after this charge. Use a charge ID from a previous response to fetch the next page.
starting_after.title: Starting After

transfer_group.description: Filters charges by the specified transfer group ID.
transfer_group.title: Transfer Group
